script.spoken: Fire tore through a chicken processing plant in Hamlet. Within minutes, twenty five workers were killed. Maintenance had patched a hydraulic line with improvised parts. It separated and sprayed fluid near a fryer. The fluid ignited. Several exits had been locked, including a fire exit. The plant had never had a safety inspection. North Carolina expanded workplace inspections.
